definition: Personality at the center of identity. Reflects individual style, preferences, and traits that shape how other diversity attributes are expressed.
Attributes inborn or established early in life and relatively stable. They strongly influence identity and self-image.
source_grouping: Primary (Loden and Rosener, 1991; Gardenswartz and Rowe, 1998)

definition: Attributes that can shift throughout life due to choices or circumstances.
source_grouping: Secondary (Loden and Rosener, 1991; Gardenswartz and Rowe, 1998); five attributes from Rijamampianina and Carmichael (2005) placed by the authors

definition: Deeply held, less visible aspects of identity. Revealed through deeper interaction and reflection.
Attributes shaped by professional role and organizational context.
